title: Awake too long is a bit like drunk

probes.question: After about how many hours awake did one study say performance begins to degrade?
True or false: a single night without sleep can slow reaction times.

image.alt: A chrome twin-bell mechanical alarm clock stands on a wooden surface in front of a window.

panels.text: We often think of staying awake as willpower. Researchers have compared it with something else: alcohol.
In a 2000 study, people who drove after being awake for 17 to 19 hours performed worse than those with a blood alcohol level of 0.05 percent.
Another study suggested performance begins to degrade after 16 hours awake, and that 21 hours awake was equivalent to 0.08 percent.
Even a single night without sleep brings slower reaction times, weaker logical reasoning and less flexible thinking.
